name: Skybox Rendering with Procedural Shading
definition: A procedural sky rendered on a back-face culled sphere using a custom shader material, combining horizon/zenith gradients, ground reflection, tiling noise clouds, and a sun disk with glow.
summary: Skybox Rendering with Procedural Shading computes background colors per-fragment via analytical functions and noise sampling, differing from kernel-based forward rendering by avoiding precomputation or separate accumulation passes.
